newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro Disney to post year results Nov 19.
newsitem.headline: Euro Disney to post year results Nov 19.

text.p: Theme park operator Euro Disney will post its 1995/96 results on November 19 instead of November 14 as initially planned, a company spokesman said on Friday.
The company has moved the date as French journalists have called a national strike for November 14, he said.
Share analysts predict the company will report a net profit for the year ended on September 30 of between 160 million and 200 million francs.

Excluding exceptionals, analysts expect a 1995/96 profit ranging between 100 million and 140 million. That would mark a second consecutive year of profit after losing more than seven billion francs in the first two years.
